sequence_points.name: Cityscape with Water Reflection
sequence_points.description: A watercolor-style painting depicting a city skyline reflected in a body of water, rendered in muted blues, grays, and whites. The composition features tall buildings along the horizon with soft, blended edges, suggesting an atmospheric or misty urban scene.

sequence_points.name: Landscape with Path and Trees
sequence_points.description: A landscape painting depicting a winding path through a wooded area with trees and distant buildings, rendered in soft earth tones and greens. The artwork is mounted on a wall within a museum setting.

sequence_points.name: Landscape with Sunset and Water
sequence_points.description: A vertical painting depicting a serene landscape with a sunset over a body of water, featuring warm hues of orange and pink in the sky transitioning to darker blues and purples near the horizon. The artwork is mounted on a wall within a museum setting.

sequence_points.name: Abstract Composition with Vertical Forms
sequence_points.description: A monochromatic abstract painting featuring vertical, column-like forms in varying shades of gray and black, mounted on a plain wall. The composition suggests architectural or urban elements through its structured arrangement.
